title: Trump Tried to Cripple Huawei. Now It Is Central to China’s A.I. Push.
summary: As China’s access to Nvidia’s advanced chips shrinks, Huawei is becoming increasingly indispensable to Beijing despite a wide technological gap with its American rival.
